title: Unnamed model limit overwrites account usage

provenance.limitations: Focused adaptation of recorded Arc behavior, not an exact historical replay.

keys.summary: A model-specific notification with no valid name overwrites account usage.
keys.scenario: Account usage is 31 percent. A malformed named-model notification reports zero percent on the same clock.

audit: Adapted identity reducer. It tests account and named-model separation plus a malformed name.
